# Encore Island — late-game feature contract (read before writing a js/f_*.js module)

Game = 2D canvas, vanilla JS, files loaded in order by index.html (util, data, world, art, items, icons, fx, sim, sim2, meta, town,
**features, tutorial, f_lands, f_gear, f_crew, f_meta, f_rivals**, render_world, render_actors, render_hud, ui, audio, main). Everything is a
global (no modules). Your file may use any global defined in files loaded BEFORE it at load time, and any global at run time.
**Only edit the files you own.** If you truly need a core change, do NOT edit core files — describe it in your final report (the lead applies it).

## Plug-in API (js/features.js — read it, it is 30 lines)
- `regFeature({ id, keep, init(st), tick(dt), drawWorld(), drawHud(), on:{ kill(e), boss(e), spawn(e,z), hurt(e,dmg), drop(spec), sell(v), land(z), chest(c), levelup(n), encore(), die(), prestige() }, pips(){ return {town:true,...} }, onLoad(st), onTour(st) })`
  - `st` = your persistent state object = `S.feat[id]` (also `fs(id)`); it is saved/loaded automatically (JSON only!). `init(st)` runs for new game, after load and after an Encore Tour: fill defaults only for missing keys. `keep:true` => state survives an Encore Tour (otherwise it resets, then `onTour(st)`).
  - `drawWorld()` runs inside the world transform (world coords; camera/zoom already applied; `vis(x,y,margin)` culls) AFTER all actors. `drawHud()` runs in screen space (vw,vh = CSS px) under the menus. Both must be cheap and must never throw.
  - `tick(dt)` runs every frame in game time while started and not held.
- `regTab(sheetId, tabId, label, draw(cw, sh) -> contentHeight, {show:()=>bool})` adds a tab to a menu sheet. Sheets: `town` (tabs crew, build), `heroes` (outfits, critters), `goals` (quests, miles, records, dex), `perks`, `more`. Tabs wrap to rows of 4. `draw` paints in sheet space (0,0 = top-left of content, `cw` = content width) and returns total content height (the sheet scrolls and hugs content). Look at SHEET_DRAW.townBuild/townCrew in ui.js for the idiom.
- `regMod(key, ()=>number)`: multipliers read by core: `dmg, rate (fire speed; >1 = faster), coin, hp, speed, magnet, xp` (multiplicative, return 1 for neutral) and additive `cap (+carry slots), crit (+chance 0..1), critmult (+x)` via modAdd. Return fast, no allocation.
- Events you can emit yourself: `fEmit('name', a, b)`. Toasts: `toast(text, iconName, lifeSeconds?)` (max two show at once — be sparing: one toast per meaningful moment).
- Tutorial hooks (js/tutorial.js, loaded before you — guard with `typeof tutAdd === 'function'`): `tutAdd({ id, order, when:()=>bool, title, text, icon, target:()=>({x,y}|null) /* WORLD pos to point at */, sheet:'goals'|'town'|... /* optional: also open this menu */, tab, block:bool /* freeze the game until dismissed (use for big intros only) */ })` and `tutHelp(id, title, text, icon)` (entry in the permanent Help library under More → How to play). EVERY feature must register: a first-encounter coach card (`when` becomes true the first time the player can actually see/use the feature) and at least one Help entry per mechanic. Copy rules: plain words, 1–3 short sentences, say what it is, what to do, and why it is good; no jargon, no riddles, no "synergy"/"meta". Name the exact button/place ("tap the Goals button", "walk onto the glowing plate").

## Useful globals (all exist)
State: `S` (S.wallet, S.pallet (vault coins), S.gems, S.crowns, S.player {x,y,hp,maxHp,helmets[],face}, S.comp, S.enemies[], S.items[], S.lands[k-1] = {k,g:{x,y,r,den:{x,y},rad,path,ia},plates[],towers[],drums,altar,...}, S.pop[] fans {role:'gather'|'fight',lvl,spec,x,y,carry[],art,id}, S.town, S.houses, S.level, S.xp, S.t (game seconds), S.groove, S.encoreT, S.stats, S.started, S.sheet, S.modal, S.cards, S.toasts), `pk(id)` (level-up card count), `coinMul()`, `pDmg()`, `cap()`, `helmVal(k)` (value of a level-k helmet), `foeHp(k)`, `foeDmg(k)`, `biomeOf(k)`, `BIOMES`, `unlockCost(k)`, `S.lands.length`.
Geometry: `HUB`, `STAGE, SELL, VAULT, FORGE, TRAY, MONU` (hub furniture, {x,y,r}), `geoOf(k)`, `radiusAt(g,ang)`, `walkable(x,y,n)`, `landAt(x,y,n)`, `wanderPoint(z)`, `LAND_GEO`. Camera `CAM`, `scl`, `vw`, `vh`, `vis(x,y,m)`.
Combat: `spawnEnemy(z,{boss})` (enemy = {k,x,y,hp,max,spd,dmg,r,boss,gold,elite,hurt,...}; you may add fields like `e.fx = {onHurt(e,dmg)->newDmg}`), `hurtEnemy(e,dmg,crit)`, `killEnemy(e)`, `dropItem(x,y,{k}|{gem:true}|{k,crown:true}|{k,bar:true})`, `S.eshots`, `hurtPlayer(d,src)`, `grantXp(n)`, `float(x,y,text,color,big)`, `starBurst(x,y,n,[colors],speed)`, `ringFx(x,y,r,color,dur)`, `puff(x,y,color,n,up)`, `flyTo(kind,x0,y0,x1,y1,opts)`, `shake(n)`, `JUICE.flash`, `sfx(name,[priority])` (shoot hit kill crit pick sell coin built unlock levelup hurt die boom gem smelt warp boss chest ui_tap ui_open ui_close combo encore dash ult pet spin win), `buzz`.
Drawing (all 2D canvas via global `ctx`): `font(px,bold=true)`, `rr(x,y,w,h,r)` (path), `plaque(x,y,w,h,r)`, `pill(x,y,w,h,c1,c2)`, `disc(x,y,r,c1,c2)`, `cbtn(x,y,w,h,enabled,kind)` kind ∈ go|gold|violet|red|pink|off, `labelPill(txt,x,y,c1,c2,px)`, `stickerText(txt,x,y,px,c1,c2,rot)`, `gbar(x,y,w,h,frac,c1,c2)`, `iconText(cx,y,drawFn,txt,color,px)` + `coinDraw`, `drawIcon(name,x,y,size)` (names: speed cap dmg rate hp magnet crit coin gem crown tower disco boom drums gate amp altar forge way egg groove star scroll trophy gift chest pet gear sound mute home mic menu lock tick heart paw), `drawGemIcon(x,y,s)`, `artDraw(spriteName,anim,frame,x,y,scale,flip)` (sprites: jasmin roxor rawclaw andy jordan kappa oni_cub … see art/atlas.json spr; anims idle/walk/attack/hurt/cast/cheer/down/die), `drawItem` family in items.js (helmets/bars/crowns), `shadow(x,y,r,a)`, `wrapText(txt,cx,y,maxW,lineH)`, `HV` palette (HV.line ink, HV.cream, HV.pink, HV.gold, HV.violet, HV.green). Menu-content helpers (sheet space): `rowCard(y,h,cw)`, `section(y,txt)`→y, `note(y,cw,txt)`→y, `stepper`, `chit(x,y,w,h,act)` (tappable area in sheet content), `card(x,y,w,h,r)`. Screen-space tap areas: `hitRect(x,y,w,h,act)` (push in drawHud; later pushes win).
HUD layout: left column under the gem/crown chips (x 8–176, y ≥ 122) and right side under the minimap (x ≥ vw-110, y 112–260) are free for small widgets; top centre has rank pill + New-land chip; guide label at y≈104; toasts y≈124+; groove bar above the dock; action buttons bottom corners. Keep widgets ≤ 44px tall, tappable ≥ 36px, never cover the joystick area (bottom 40%).
Persistent progress that must survive reloads goes in your `st` (JSON). Do not use localStorage directly.

## Testing
`tests/encore_island_lib.mjs` exports `loadEI()` → the `EI` hook object (headless, stubbed canvas). Write `tests/encore_island_<yourfeature>.test.mjs` (use `harness()` from `./no_room_for_heroes_lib.mjs`: `t.ok(cond,msg)`, `t.done()`), covering: registration, state defaults + JSON round-trip through `EI.serialize()`/`EI.applySave(...)`, the main numbers, no throw while ticking 20 s and `EI.draw()` with each of your tabs open (`EI.openSheet('goals','yourtab')`), and (if any) Encore Tour behaviour (`EI.prestige()`). Run `node tests/encore_island.test.mjs` and your suite; both must pass. Visual check: `cd /home/user/Games && python3 -m http.server <your port> &`, Playwright from '/opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs', chromium at '/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome', viewport 412×860 @2x, page `http://localhost:<port>/encore_island/index.html`, click once to start, use `EI.S` to set up state (e.g. `EI.addLand()`, `S.wallet=1e6`, `S.player.x=...`) then screenshot and LOOK at it. Screenshots go in the scratchpad dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Games/a684fb3b-99c9-54f8-94eb-4951ed007b0a/scratchpad/ with your feature id as prefix.

## Quality bar
Cute, juicy, readable on a phone; no overlapping UI; no toast spam; costs are significant (this is a late-game feature: think thousands to millions of coins, scaled with `helmVal(S.lands.length)` or lands count where sensible); nothing may break saving, offline earnings or Encore Tours; 60fps (no per-frame allocation in tick/draw loops beyond tiny objects). Pure additions: do not change existing balance except through regMod.
